operation.name: ED50 to WGS 84 (18)
operation.why: Best stated accuracy (1 m) for the UK North Sea; area 'Europe - common offshore' contains all points. Inverse UTM 31N (conversion) then EPSG:1311.

assumptions: Read as EPSG:23031 ED50 / UTM zone 31N, metres, easting first, full (untruncated) eastings.
notes: Points fall at about 1.1-1.3E, west of the UK/Norway median line, so the UK-applicable 1311 is used rather than Norway's 1613. Round trip to UTM checked internally within about 0.001 m (GIGS tolerance 0.006 m).
